;Disasters and accidents
*At least one person is killed and six others are injured after a crane collapses onto an apartment building in [[Dallas, Texas]], amid severe weather. [https://abc13.com/amp/weather/1-dead-after-crane-collapses-over-apartment-during-dallas-storms/5339379/ (KTRK-TV)]
*A woman is killed when a police officer driving under the influence crashes into a restaurant in Illinois. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/police-drunk-off-duty-police-officer-crashes-into-restaurant-kills-woman/ar-AACEFdZ?ocid=spartanntp (MSN)]

;International relations
*Vietnamese customs say it will crack down on goods of Chinese origin illegally relabeled "Made in Vietnam" by exporters seeking to avoid [[United States|American]] tariffs on Chinese imports. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-06-10/vietnam-cracks-down-on-chinese-made-goods-being-shipped-to-u-s (Bloomberg)]

;Law and crime
*Former [[Boston Red Sox]] [[designated hitter]] [[David Ortiz]] is [[Shooting of David Ortiz|shot]] in the [[Dominican Republic]] during a reported robbery attempt. He is expected to fully recover following surgery. [https://heavy.com/sports/2019/06/david-ortiz-shot-video-condition/amp/ (Heavy)] [https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/26937958/red-sox-legend-ortiz-stable-shooting-dr (ESPN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Kazakh presidential election]]
**[[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] is elected as the next [[President of Kazakhstan|president]] of [[Kazakhstan]]. The election was marred by the arrests of more than 500 protesters and was not declared to be fully democratic by [[OSCE]] observers. [https://www.dw.com/en/kazakhstan-elects-tokayev-as-nazarbayev-successor-as-hundreds-protest/a-49123470 (DW)]
*[[2019 Moldovan constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Moldova]] dissolves the national parliament and removes Moldovan President [[Igor Dodon]] from office, appointing former prime minister [[Pavel Filip]] in his place. Dodon, as well as the [[Parliament of Moldova]] defy the move, hence triggering a [[constitutional crisis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-moldova-politics/moldovan-parties-agree-to-form-government-after-months-of-deadlock-idUSKCN1T90MT?feedType=RSS&feedName=worldNews&&rpc=401 (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/moldova-parties-form-government-despite-court-rulings/a-49116723 (DW)]
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests|Extradition Law controversy]]
**Over 1 million people gather in the streets of [[Hong Kong]] to protest a new controversial law which would allow the city to extradite fugitives to China. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/08/asia/hong-kong-extradition-bill-protest-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
**Several text and audio messages between [[Brazil|Brazilian]] judge [[Sérgio Moro]] and lead prosecutor [[Deltan Dallagnol]] are leaked, casting doubt over the trial of former [[President of Brazil|Brazilian President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] on the grounds of illegal collaboration between court and prosecution. The leaks also point to interference in the [[2018 Brazilian general election|2018 elections]] by Operation Car Wash's task force officials. [https://theintercept.com/series/secret-brazil-archive/ (The Intercept)]

;Sports
* [[2018–19 UEFA Nations League]]
** The [[Portugal national football team]] defeats the [[Netherlands national football team|Netherlands]] in the final of the [[2018–19 UEFA Nations League]], 1–0, to become the first champions of the tournament. [https://www.newsday.com/sports/portugal-beats-netherlands-to-win-1st-nations-league-final-1.32181522 (''Newsday'')]
* [[2019 French Open – Men's Singles|2019 French Open]]
** Spaniard [[Rafael Nadal]], who turned 33 this past Monday, defeats Austrian [[Dominic Thiem]] 6–3, 5–7, 6–1, 6–1 for his 12th French Open men's singles championship, and his 18th [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] title. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/09/sports/french-open-rafael-nadal-dominic-thiem.html (''The New York Times'')]
